caption: The drawing depicts a single ornamental object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object is a carved wooden element, predominantly brown with subtle variations in tone that suggest depth and shadow. It has an overall circular or flower-like shape, featuring a symmetrical arrangement of eight rounded, leaf-like projections or petals radiating from a central raised point. The surface is detailed with curved lines to indicate wood grain and contour. Four small circular perforations are present—three near the outer edges of certain petals, and one closer to the center—suggesting attachment points. At the base, a straight, tapering stem-like extension projects downward, also brown with shading, and terminating in a slightly irregular end. The name “Clarence Searr '28” is handwritten in gray below the object, centered near the bottom edge of the paper.
title: Rosette
